name: Calgary
feasibility: high for revenue/value and spatial services
summary: Calgary is the strongest candidate for an Edmonton-like revenue/value map because open parcel assessment data includes assessed values, classes, community codes/names, land size, and geometry.
privacy: Parcel assessment records include roll numbers, addresses, parcel polygons, construction year, and property details; aggregate to communities and avoid publishing parcel-level web artifacts.

assessment.caveat: Excludes titled parking stalls/storage, machinery/equipment, and linear property.

historical_assessment.caveat: 10M+ rows; use Socrata server-side aggregation rather than casual bulk downloads.
